name: The Complete Absinthe Set
description: Picture yourself in Paris at a dimly lit cabaret, sipping from coupe glasses with your couple friends F. Scott and Zelda. Bring the Belle Epoque to your own cozy den with this vintage-inspired absinthe set: It comes with everything that would have been included in a 19th-century absinthe service for one. Cold water drips over the sugar cube, through the perforated spoon and into to the carafe to mix with the absinthe. Just add stimulating conversation and Josephine Baker on the record player. Glasses and carafe mouth-blown in China. Hand-stamped stainless steel spoon and hand-painted saucer made in India. Sugar cube sourced from the Netherlands.
